[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-12w[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Detached proc execution for sase sudo[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Approving a sudo gate takes over the terminal only long enough to [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]authenticate; the reviewed commands then run under a detached, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]supervised proc so the TUI is usable again immediately, and the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]gate still settles with a validated ledger when execution finishes.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202609/sudo_proc_execution.md[/#87AFFF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Runner auth-then-spawn mode and handshake wire[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]runner[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]runner: teach sase_sudo_runner (sase-core) a detach mode that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]authenticates on the TTY, spawns a detached root executor for the sealed[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]manifest, invalidates the sudo timestamp, and prints a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]started-handshake; add the handshake wire type, a --capabilities probe, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and sase_core_py bindings.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Detached sudo answer path and finalize proc[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]cli[dim] · [dim][/dim]after runner[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cli: add an opt-in --detach path to `sase sudo answer` that runs the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]runner in auth-then-spawn mode, records a durable in-flight execution [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]record, and submits a supervised finalize proc; add the internal `sase [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sudo finalize` subcommand that waits for the executor, validates the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ledger, answers the gate, and settles the gate shell.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]TUI handoff returns after authentication[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]tui[dim] · [dim][/dim]after cli[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]tui: make the ACE sudo terminal handoff pass --detach, handle the new [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]execution_started payload, toast the background handoff, and surface the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]executing state on the sudo gate and its finalize proc.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Detached execution for remote sudo targets[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]remote[dim] · [dim][/dim]after cli[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]remote: extend `sase sudo exec` and the SSH relay so a remote target [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]authenticates interactively, spawns its own detached executor, and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]local finalize proc polls for and fetches the remote ledger; gate the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]path on an additive contract capability with a synchronous fallback.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Detach becomes the default answer mode[/bold #D7AFFF]                        [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]default[dim] · [dim][/dim]after tui, remote[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]default: flip `sase sudo answer --run` to detach by default with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]--no-detach keeping the synchronous path, matching the shell-backed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`sase gate answer` convention; update help text and tests.[/#D7D7AF]
